knowledge:
- key_parameters: clean=specifies if the library should be cleaned during reading or building ;; intensity.cutoff=threshold for removing low intensity ions (default is 5) ;; conf.cutoff=threshold for removing low confidence peptides (default is 0.99) ;; nomod=logical, whether to remove peptides with modifications ;; nomc=logical, whether to remove peptides with missed cleavages ;; method=retention time alignment method, e.g., "hydro" or "hydrosequence" (defaults to time-based if not specified) ;; outputFormat=format of the output library ("peakview" or "openswath") ;; max.fdrpass=upper threshold value for the number of samples passing the FDR threshold (<0.01) ;; max.peptide=upper threshold value for the number of peptides that a protein has ;; method in quantification.accuracy=consistency measurement method ("cv", "cor", or "bland.altman")
- alternatives: Time-based retention time alignment (recommended if RT correlation R^2 > 0.8) vs. Hydrophobicity-based alignment (method="hydro" or method="hydrosequence", using SSRCalc-predicted hydrophobicity index, preferred when RT correlation is lower).
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have a local "seed" SWATH assay library and want to extend its coverage using an "add-on" library (local or public like SWATHAtlas) to extract SWATH data, or when you want to perform reliability checks and statistical analysis on SWATH results extracted using different libraries (seed vs. extended).
- pitfalls: Do not merge libraries if the matching quality is poor (recommended thresholds: RT.corsqr > 0.8, RT.RMSE < 2 minutes, and RII.cormedian > 0.6). Reliability checking functions are only compatible with SWATH result files extracted using PeakView with SWATH Acquisition MicroApp. SWATH result checking requires the Excel worksheets "Area - peptides" and "FDR" to exist.

workflows.name: build_extended_library
workflows.intent: Clean, check matching quality, align retention times, and merge a seed library and an add-on library to build and export an extended SWATH assay library.
input: seed_library.txt (tab-delimited or comma-delimited library file in PeakView or OpenSWATH format)
addon_library.txt (tab-delimited or comma-delimited library file in PeakView or OpenSWATH format)
hydro_index.txt (optional hydrophobicity index file with Sequence, Length, and Hydrophobicity columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Load libraries using readLibFile ;; 2. Clean libraries using cleanLib ;; 3. Check matching quality using checkQuality ;; 4. Visualize matching quality using plotRTCor, plotRTResd, plotRIICor, or plotAll ;; 5. Build the extended library using buildSpectraLibPair (with time-based or hydrophobicity-based alignment) ;; 6. Export the extended library using outputLib
workflows.code:
filenames <- c("Lib2.txt", "Lib3.txt") 
libfiles <- paste(system.file("files",package="SwathXtend"),
	filenames,sep="/")
Lib2 <- readLibFile(libfiles[1], clean=TRUE)
Lib3 <- readLibFile(libfiles[2], clean=TRUE)
Lib2 <- cleanLib(Lib2, intensity.cutoff = 5, conf.cutoff = 0.99, 
			nomod = FALSE, nomc = FALSE)
Lib3 <- cleanLib(Lib3, intensity.cutoff = 5, conf.cutoff = 0.99, 
			nomod = FALSE, nomc = FALSE)
checkQuality(Lib2, Lib3)
plotRTCor(Lib2, Lib3, "Lib2", "Lib3")
plotRTResd(Lib2, Lib3)
plotRIICor(Lib2, Lib3)
plotAll(Lib2, Lib3, file="allplots.xlsx")
Lib2_3 <- buildSpectraLibPair(libfiles[1], libfiles[2], clean=T, 
				nomc=T, nomod=T, plot=F, 
				outputFormat = "peakview",
				outputFile = "Lib2_3.txt")	
hydroFile <- paste(system.file("files",package="SwathXtend"),
				"hydroIndex.txt",sep="/")
hydro <- readLibFile(hydroFile, type="hydro")
head(hydro)					
Lib2_3.hydro <- buildSpectraLibPair(libfiles[1], libfiles[2], hydro, 
				clean=T, 
				nomc=T, nomod=T, plot=F, 
				method="hydro",
				outputFormat = "peakview",
				outputFile = "Lib2_3.txt")	
outputLib(Lib2_3, filename="Lib2_3.txt", format="peakview")

workflows.name: reliability_check_swath
workflows.intent: Compare SWATH results extracted using the seed library versus the extended library to check coverage and quantification consistency.
input: swath_result_seed.xlsx (PeakView SWATH result Excel file for seed library)
swath_result_ext.xlsx (PeakView SWATH result Excel file for extended library)
workflows.stages: 1. Check library coverage using reliabilityCheckLibrary ;; 2. Run comprehensive SWATH results check using reliabilityCheckSwath ;; 3. Read FDR worksheets using readWorkbook ;; 4. Calculate FDR pass statistics using fdr.crit ;; 5. Read Peptide worksheets using readWorkbook ;; 6. Calculate quantification accuracy/consistency using quantification.accuracy
workflows.code:
libfiles <- paste(system.file("files",package="SwathXtend"),
		c("Lib2.txt", "Lib2_3.txt"),sep="/")
res = reliabilityCheckLibrary(libfiles[1], libfiles[2])
fswaths = paste(system.file("files",package="SwathXtend"),
	c("Swath_result_seed.xlsx", "Swath_result_ext.xlsx"), 
	sep="/")
res = reliabilityCheckSwath(fswaths[1], fswaths[2], max.fdrpass=8, 
	max.peptide=2)
fdr.seed = readWorkbook(fswaths[1], sheet='FDR')
fdr.ext = readWorkbook(fswaths[2], sheet='FDR')
fdr.seed = fdr.crit(fdr.seed)
fdr.ext = fdr.crit(fdr.ext)
head(fdr.ext[,c(1:2,ncol(fdr.ext))])
swa.seed = readWorkbook(fswaths[1], 2)
swa.ext = readWorkbook(fswaths[2], 2)
fdr.seed = fdr.seed[fdr.seed$nfdr.pass > 0,]
fdr.ext = fdr.ext[fdr.ext$nfdr.pass > 0,]
res = quantification.accuracy(swa.seed[fdr.seed$nfdr.pass >= 1,], 
	swa.ext[fdr.ext$nfdr.pass >= 1,], method="cv")[[1]]
